page.title: Try Swiftrix 3D: floor plans furnished in 3D | Swiftrix
page.desc: Live demo of Swiftrix 3D. Pick a ready-made floor plan, a studio, a family home or an office, furnish it with IKEA pieces and see it in 3D.
page.h1: Try a floor plan, furnished in 3D
page.hero: Pick one of six ready-made floor plans, from a studio to a big office, add IKEA furniture and watch the layout, the walking routes and the 3D room update.
page.lead1: Everything runs in your browser. Nothing is uploaded and nothing is saved.
page.note: This is a showcase with prepared plans and furniture. The full program reads your own floor plan and any shop link.
page.frame: Swiftrix 3D demo: floor plans and IKEA furniture
page.h2b: What Swiftrix 3D does for your business
cards: Upload a plan as an image or PDF. The program finds the rooms, walls, doors and windows and works out the real measurements.
It proposes three arrangements per room and measures walking routes, clear space and distances, so the layout is practical, not just pretty.
Paste an IKEA or other shop link. The program reads the size from the page, builds a 3D model from the product pictures and fits the room around it.
Interactive 3D, top views, eye-level views and HD pictures, ready for your customers, your listings or your website.
page.h2c: Show the room before it is furnished
minis: Show every customer their own room furnished with your range.
Furnish flats and houses before they are finished.
Test layouts in minutes and present them in 3D.
Plan desks, meeting rooms and break rooms.
page.cta: Swiftrix 3D is sold as a program for companies. Tell us what you need and we will show you a demo with your own plan.
